# Shared variables across tests

$script:VOID_PROCESSOR_ID = $null

$script:fail              = 0

# ============================================================================
# HELPERS
# ============================================================================
function Write-Banner { param([string]$t)
    Write-Host "`n╔$("═"*68)╗" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "║  $($t.PadRight(66))║" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "╚$("═"*68)╝" -ForegroundColor Cyan
}

function Write-Header { param([string]$t)
    Write-Host "`n$("─"*70)" -ForegroundColor DarkCyan
    Write-Host "  $t" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "$("─"*70)" -ForegroundColor DarkCyan
}

function Write-Step { param([string]$t)
    Write-Host "`n  ► $t" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

function Pass { param([string]$t)
    Write-Host "    ✓ $t" -ForegroundColor Green
    $script:pass++
}

function Fail { param([string]$t, [string]$detail="")
    Write-Host "    ✗ $t" -ForegroundColor Red
    if ($detail) { Write-Host "      $detail" -ForegroundColor DarkRed }
    $script:fail++
}

function Info { param([string]$t)
    Write-Host "      $t" -ForegroundColor White
}

function Warn { param([string]$t)
    Write-Host "    ⚠ $t" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

function New-IKey {
    return "ikey_$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMddHHmmssff')_$([System.Guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0,6))"
}

function Get-ErrorDetail { param($ex)
    try {
        return $ex.ErrorDetails.Message | ConvertFrom-Json
    } catch {
        return @{ detail = $ex.Exception.Message }
    }
}

function Get-StatusCode { param($ex)
    try { return $ex.Exception.Response.StatusCode.value__ }
    catch { return 0 }
}

# ============================================================================
# TEST 1: HEALTH CHECK - BANK CONNECTOR
# ============================================================================
Write-Header "TEST 1: HEALTH CHECK - BANK CONNECTOR"

Write-Step "Checking Bank Connector health"
try {
    $h = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$BANK_CONNECTOR/health" -Method GET -TimeoutSec 10

    if ($h.status -eq "ok") {
        Pass "Bank Connector healthy"
        Info "Service: $($h.service)"

        if ($h.stripe_connected) {
            Pass "Stripe API connected"
        } else {
            Warn "Stripe NOT connected - check STRIPE_SECRET_KEY in .env"
            Warn "Tests 2-12 will fail without valid Stripe key"
        }

        foreach ($cb in $h.circuit_breakers.PSObject.Properties) {
            Info "Circuit Breaker [$($cb.Name)]: state=$($cb.Value.state) failures=$($cb.Value.failure_count)"
        }
    } else {
        Fail "Bank Connector unhealthy"
    }
} catch {
    Fail "Bank Connector unreachable"
    Info "Run: docker-compose logs bank-connector"
    exit 1
}

Write-Step "Checking other services"
foreach ($svc in @(
    @{ name="API Gateway";   url="$API_GATEWAY/health" },
    @{ name="Auth Service";  url="$AUTH_SERVICE/health" },
    @{ name="Fraud Service"; url="$FRAUD_SERVICE/health" }
)) {
    try {
        $h = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $svc.url -Method GET -TimeoutSec 10
        if ($h.status -eq "ok") { Pass "$($svc.name) healthy" }
        else { Warn "$($svc.name) unhealthy" }
    } catch { Warn "$($svc.name) unreachable" }
}

# TEST 2: DIRECT AUTHORIZE - VISA SUCCESS
# ============================================================================
Write-Header "TEST 2: DIRECT AUTHORIZE - VISA SUCCESS"

Write-Step "Authorizing \$50.00 Visa card"
try {
    $authBody = @{
        payment_id      = "pi_direct_$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMddHHmmssff')"
        merchant_id     = "m_123"
        amount          = 5000
        currency        = "usd"
        idempotency_key = New-IKey
        description     = "Direct bank connector test"
        card            = @{
            number    = "4242424242424242"
            exp_month = 12
            exp_year  = 2026
            cvc       = "123"
        }
    } | ConvertTo-Json

    $auth = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$BANK_CONNECTOR/authorize" `
        -Method POST -Body $authBody -ContentType "application/json"

    $script:PROCESSOR_ID = $auth.processor_id

    Pass "Visa authorization successful"
    Info "Processor ID   : $($auth.processor_id)"
    Info "Auth Code      : $($auth.authorization_code)"
    Info "Processor      : $($auth.processor)"
    Info "Card           : $($auth.card_brand) **** $($auth.card_last4)"
    Info "Amount         : `$$($auth.amount/100) $($auth.currency)"
} catch {
    $e = Get-ErrorDetail $_
    Fail "Visa authorization failed" "$($e.detail)"
    Info "Check: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY in .env must be real key not placeholder"
    exit 1
}

Write-Step "Testing card 4000000000000002 (generic decline)"
try {
    $d = @{
        payment_id      = "pi_dec1_$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMddHHmmssff')"
        merchant_id     = "m_123"
        amount          = 5000
        currency        = "usd"
        idempotency_key = New-IKey
        card            = @{ number="4000000000000002"; exp_month=12; exp_year=2026; cvc="123" }
    } | ConvertTo-Json

    Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$BANK_CONNECTOR/authorize" -Method POST -Body $d -ContentType "application/json"
    Fail "Should have been declined!"
} catch {
    $sc = Get-StatusCode $_
    if ($sc -eq 402) {
        $e = Get-ErrorDetail $_
        Pass "Generic decline handled correctly (402)"
        Info "Code         : $($e.detail.code)"
        Info "Decline Code : $($e.detail.decline_code)"
        Info "Message      : $($e.detail.message)"
    } else {
        Pass "Generic decline rejected (HTTP $sc)"
    }
}

# ============================================================================
# TEST 10: IDEMPOTENCY
# ============================================================================
Write-Header "TEST 10: IDEMPOTENCY - NO DOUBLE CHARGES"

Write-Step "Sending same request twice with same idempotency key"
try {
    $iKey    = New-IKey
    $idemBody = @{
        payment_id      = "pi_idem_$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMddHHmmss')"
        merchant_id     = "m_123"
        amount          = 3000
        currency        = "usd"
        idempotency_key = $iKey
        card            = @{ number="4242424242424242"; exp_month=12; exp_year=2026; cvc="123" }
    } | ConvertTo-Json

    $first = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$BANK_CONNECTOR/authorize" `
        -Method POST -Body $idemBody -ContentType "application/json"
    Info "First request  processor_id: $($first.processor_id)"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 1

    $second = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$BANK_CONNECTOR/authorize" `
        -Method POST -Body $idemBody -ContentType "application/json"
    Info "Second request processor_id: $($second.processor_id)"

    if ($first.processor_id -eq $second.processor_id) {
        Pass "Idempotency working - same processor ID returned"
        Info "Idempotent hit: $($second.raw_response.idempotent)"
    } else {
        Fail "Different IDs returned - double charge risk!"
        Info "First  : $($first.processor_id)"
        Info "Second : $($second.processor_id)"
    }
} catch {
    $e = Get-ErrorDetail $_
    Fail "Idempotency test failed" "$($e.detail)"
}

# TEST 13: MERCHANT - AUTHORIZE ONLY (capture=false)
# ============================================================================
Write-Header "TEST 13: MERCHANT - AUTHORIZE ONLY (capture=false)"

Write-Step "Creating \$150.00 merchant payment - authorize only"
try {
    $mHeaders = @{
        "Content-Type"    = "application/json"
        "Authorization"   = "Bearer $SECRET_KEY"
        "Idempotency-Key" = New-IKey
    }

    $mBody = @{
        amount      = 15000
        currency    = "usd"
        customer    = @{
            email = "merchant@example.com"
            name  = "John Merchant"
            phone = "+1234567890"
        }
        card        = @{
            number    = "4242424242424242"
            exp_month = 12
            exp_year  = 2026
            cvc       = "123"
        }
        order_id    = "order_$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMddHHmmss')"
        description = "Merchant test - enterprise subscription"
        metadata    = @{ plan="enterprise"; seats=10; billing="annual" }
        capture     = $false
    } | ConvertTo-Json

    $mPayment = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$API_GATEWAY/v1/merchant/payment_intents" `
        -Method POST -Headers $mHeaders -Body $mBody

    $script:M_PAYMENT_ID = $mPayment.payment_id

    Pass "Merchant payment authorized"
    Info "Payment ID   : $($mPayment.payment_id)"
    Info "Status       : $($mPayment.status)"
    Info "Auth Code    : $($mPayment.authorization_code)"
    Info "Card         : $($mPayment.card_brand) **** $($mPayment.card_last4)"
    Info "Amount       : `$$($mPayment.amount/100)"
} catch {
    $e = Get-ErrorDetail $_
    Fail "Merchant payment failed" "$($e.detail)"
    exit 1
}

    $mRefundBody = @{

# TEST 16: MERCHANT - VOID
# ============================================================================
Write-Header "TEST 16: MERCHANT - VOID AUTHORIZED PAYMENT"

Write-Step "Creating new \$60.00 payment to void"
try {
    $voidCreateHeaders = @{
        "Content-Type"    = "application/json"
        "Authorization"   = "Bearer $SECRET_KEY"
        "Idempotency-Key" = New-IKey
    }

    $voidCreateBody = @{
        amount   = 6000
        currency = "usd"
        customer = @{ email="void@example.com"; name="Void Test" }
        card     = @{ number="4242424242424242"; exp_month=12; exp_year=2026; cvc="123" }
        description = "Payment to be voided"
        capture  = $false
    } | ConvertTo-Json

    $voidPayment = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$API_GATEWAY/v1/merchant/payment_intents" `
        -Method POST -Headers $voidCreateHeaders -Body $voidCreateBody

    Pass "Payment created for void: $($voidPayment.payment_id)"
    Info "Status : $($voidPayment.status)"
    Info "Amount : `$$($voidPayment.amount/100)"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2

    Write-Step "Voiding the payment"

    $voidExecHeaders = @{
        "Content-Type"  = "application/json"
        "Authorization" = "Bearer $SECRET_KEY"
    }

    $voidExecBody = @{
        payment_id = $voidPayment.payment_id
        reason     = "Customer cancelled order"
    } | ConvertTo-Json

    $voidResult = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$API_GATEWAY/v1/merchant/voids" `
        -Method POST -Headers $voidExecHeaders -Body $voidExecBody

    if ($voidResult.status -eq "voided") {
        Pass "Payment voided successfully"
        Info "Status    : $($voidResult.status)"
        Info "Reference : $($voidResult.void_reference)"
    } else {
        Fail "Unexpected void status: $($voidResult.status)"
    }
} catch {
    $e = Get-ErrorDetail $_
    Fail "Merchant void failed" "$($e.detail)"
}

# TEST 17: CUSTOMER - GET JWT TOKEN
# ============================================================================
Write-Header "TEST 17: CUSTOMER - GET JWT TOKEN"

Write-Step "Getting JWT token for customer"
try {
    $jwtBody = @{
        sub    = "cust_$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMddHHmmss')"
        email  = "customer@gmail.com"
        roles  = @("customer")
        scopes = @(
            "payment_session:create"
            "payment_session:read_own"
            "payment_method:tokenize"
            "payment_intent:confirm_own"
            "public_config:read"
        )
    } | ConvertTo-Json

    $jwtResp = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$AUTH_SERVICE/token" `
        -Method POST -Body $jwtBody -ContentType "application/json"

    $script:JWT = $jwtResp.access_token

    if ($script:JWT) {
        Pass "JWT token obtained"
        Info "Token  : $($script:JWT.Substring(0,60))..."
        Info "Type   : $($jwtResp.token_type)"
    } else {
        Fail "JWT token empty"
        exit 1
    }
} catch {
    Fail "JWT token failed" $_
    exit 1
}

# ============================================================================
# TEST 18: CUSTOMER - CREATE PAYMENT SESSION
# ============================================================================
Write-Header "TEST 18: CUSTOMER - CREATE PAYMENT SESSION"

$cHeaders = @{
    "Content-Type"      = "application/json"
    "X-Publishable-Key" = $PUBLISHABLE_KEY
    "Authorization"     = "Bearer $script:JWT"
}

Write-Step "Creating payment session for \$99.00"
try {
    $sessionBody = @{
        cart_id     = "cart_$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMddHHmmssff')"
        order_id    = "order_$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMddHHmmssff')"
        amount      = 9900
        currency    = "usd"
        description = "Customer test order - Premium Widget"
        metadata    = @{
            test        = "bank_connector_e2e"
            environment = "development"
        }
        capture     = $true
    } | ConvertTo-Json

    $session = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$API_GATEWAY/v1/customer/payment_sessions" `
        -Method POST -Headers $cHeaders -Body $sessionBody

    $script:SESSION_ID = $session.session_id

    if ($script:SESSION_ID) {
        Pass "Payment session created"
        Info "Session ID : $($session.session_id)"
        Info "Amount     : `$$($session.amount/100) $($session.currency.ToUpper())"
        Info "Status     : $($session.status)"
        Info "Capture    : $($session.capture)"
        Info "Expires    : $($session.expires_at)"
    } else {
        Fail "Session ID not returned"
        exit 1
    }
} catch {
    $e = Get-ErrorDetail $_
    Fail "Session creation failed" "$($e.detail)"
    exit 1
}

# ============================================================================
# TEST 19: CUSTOMER - TOKENIZE CARD
# ============================================================================
Write-Header "TEST 19: CUSTOMER - TOKENIZE MASTERCARD"

Write-Step "Tokenizing Mastercard 5555555555554444"
try {
    $tokenBody = @{
        card_number = "5555555555554444"
        exp_month   = 12
        exp_year    = 2026
        cvc         = "123"
    } | ConvertTo-Json

    $token = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$API_GATEWAY/v1/customer/payment_methods/tokenize" `
        -Method POST -Headers $cHeaders -Body $tokenBody

    $script:PM_TOKEN = $token.payment_method_token

    if ($script:PM_TOKEN) {
        Pass "Card tokenized successfully"
        Info "Token   : $($token.payment_method_token)"
        Info "Brand   : $($token.brand)"
        Info "Last4   : $($token.last4)"
        Info "Status  : $($token.status)"
        Info "Expires : $($token.expires_at)"
    } else {
        Fail "Token not returned"
        exit 1
    }
} catch {
    $e = Get-ErrorDetail $_
    Fail "Tokenization failed" "$($e.detail)"
    exit 1
}

# ============================================================================
# TEST 20: CUSTOMER - CONFIRM PAYMENT (FULL FLOW)
# ============================================================================
Write-Header "TEST 20: CUSTOMER - CONFIRM PAYMENT (FULL END-TO-END)"

Write-Step "Confirming payment with session + token"
try {
    $confirmBody = @{
        session_id           = $script:SESSION_ID
        payment_method_token = $script:PM_TOKEN
    } | ConvertTo-Json

    $payment = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$API_GATEWAY/v1/customer/payment_intents/confirm" `
        -Method POST -Headers $cHeaders -Body $confirmBody

    Pass "Customer payment confirmed!"
    Info "Payment ID     : $($payment.payment.payment_id)"
    Info "Status         : $($payment.payment.status)"
    Info "Amount         : `$$($payment.payment.amount/100)"
    Info "Amount Captured: `$$($payment.payment.amount_captured/100)"
    Info "Card           : $($payment.payment.card_brand) **** $($payment.payment.card_last4)"
    Info "Auth Code      : $($payment.payment.authorization_code)"
    Info "Session Status : $($payment.session.status)"
    Info "Confirmed At   : $($payment.session.confirmed_at)"
} catch {
    $rawErr = $_.ErrorDetails.Message
    Fail "Customer payment confirmation failed"
    try {
        $e = $rawErr | ConvertFrom-Json
        Info "Code      : $($e.detail.code)"
        Info "Message   : $($e.detail.message)"
        Info "RiskScore : $($e.detail.risk_score)"
        if ($e.detail.code -eq "fraud_detected") {
            Warn "Fraud service blocked - velocity triggered from earlier tests"
            Warn "Fix: docker exec postgres psql -U payments -d fraud_db -c 'TRUNCATE fraud_checks, ml_training_samples CASCADE;'"
        }
    } catch {
        Info "Raw error: $rawErr"
    }
}

# ============================================================================
# FINAL SUMMARY
# ============================================================================
Write-Host "`n" -NoNewline
Write-Banner "FINAL TEST RESULTS"

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "  Total  : $($script:pass + $script:fail)" -ForegroundColor White
Write-Host "  Passed : $($script:pass)" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "  Failed : $($script:fail)" -ForegroundColor Red

Write-Host "`n  Key IDs:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "    Bank Connector Processor ID : $($script:PROCESSOR_ID)"   -ForegroundColor White
Write-Host "    Merchant Payment ID         : $($script:M_PAYMENT_ID)"   -ForegroundColor White
Write-Host "    Customer Session ID         : $($script:SESSION_ID)"     -ForegroundColor White
Write-Host "    Customer Payment Token      : $($script:PM_TOKEN)"       -ForegroundColor White

Write-Host "`n  Tests Covered:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
$tests = @(
    " 1. Health checks (all services)",
    " 2. Direct authorize - Visa",
    " 3. Direct capture",
    " 4. Direct partial refund",
    " 5. Direct authorize + void",
    " 6. Declined - generic",
    " 7. Declined - insufficient funds",
    " 8. Declined - lost card",
    " 9. Declined - stolen card",
    "10. Idempotency",
    "11. Transaction history",
    "12. Stats + circuit breakers",
    "13. Merchant authorize only",
    "14. Merchant capture",
    "15. Merchant partial refund",
    "16. Merchant void",
    "17. Customer JWT",
    "18. Customer payment session",
    "19. Customer card tokenization",
    "20. Customer payment confirm"
)
foreach ($t in $tests) {
    Write-Host "    •$t" -ForegroundColor White
}

Write-Host ""
if ($script:fail -eq 0) {
    Write-Host "  ✓ ALL 20 TESTS PASSED!" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "  ✓ Stripe is processing real payments!" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "  ✓ Fraud service protecting payments!" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "  ✓ Full flow: Gateway → Fraud → Bank Connector → Stripe" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "`n  Check Stripe Dashboard: https://dashboard.stripe.com/test/payments" -ForegroundColor Cyan
} else {
    Write-Host "  ⚠ $($script:fail) TEST(S) FAILED" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Write-Host "`n  Common fixes:" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Write-Host "    Fraud velocity : docker exec postgres psql -U payments -d fraud_db -c 'TRUNCATE fraud_checks, ml_training_samples CASCADE;'" -ForegroundColor Gray
    Write-Host "    Stripe key     : check STRIPE_SECRET_KEY in .env" -ForegroundColor Gray
    Write-Host "    BC logs        : docker-compose logs --tail=30 bank-connector" -ForegroundColor Gray
    Write-Host "    Pay logs       : docker-compose logs --tail=30 payment-service" -ForegroundColor Gray
}
Write-Host ""
